# Dagpeek

> A free menu bar and tray app for Mac and Windows, by Ailio, that shows what a Dagu server is running, what's queued and what failed. It can stop, retry or dequeue runs. The app sends an anonymous daily usage count, which can be turned off.

- [Home](https://dagpeek.com/): what it does and how to install it
- [Source](https://github.com/ailio-technologies-inc/dagpeek): MIT licensed

Install: brew install --cask ailio-technologies-inc/tap/dagpeek
